executiveStoryObjective: Diagnose the self-assessed environment, interpret linked exposure pathways and design the target fraud-control response over 12 months.

movements.title: Executive diagnosis
movements.objective: State what MK concluded from the recorded assessment.
movements.transitionPurpose: Clarify the analytical basis and boundary before interpretation.
movements.requiredManagementTakeaway: Management should understand the current position, its pattern and the leadership priorities.

movements.title: Analytical basis
movements.objective: Explain the self-assessment basis and assurance boundary once.
movements.transitionPurpose: Move from score shape to the themes that explain concentration.
movements.requiredManagementTakeaway: The result is strategic analysis and control design, not independent operating verification.

movements.title: Systemic themes
movements.objective: Explain the cross-cutting patterns and interactions supplied by the deterministic layer.
movements.transitionPurpose: Move from patterns to the material findings supporting them.
movements.requiredManagementTakeaway: The material story is created by linked conditions, not isolated question scores.

movements.title: Material findings
movements.objective: Interpret the material findings in their broader control-system context.
movements.transitionPurpose: Show how these conditions create plausible pathways to manage.
movements.requiredManagementTakeaway: The findings require connected treatment across owners, controls and oversight.

movements.title: Fraud exposure and scenarios
movements.objective: Narrate approved fraud pathways without making allegations.
movements.transitionPurpose: Use the pathways to explain why the target control environment matters.
movements.requiredManagementTakeaway: Scenario logic should inform prevention, monitoring, containment and response design.

movements.title: Target fraud-control environment
movements.objective: Explain the target-state control blueprints and connected operating design.
movements.transitionPurpose: Move from target design to the decisions required to make it real.
movements.requiredManagementTakeaway: Controls become useful when objective, ownership, proof, challenge and effectiveness are explicit.

movements.title: Leadership decisions
movements.objective: Explain the genuine executive choices, approved options and trade-offs.
movements.transitionPurpose: Sequence the selected direction through the twelve-month blueprint.
movements.requiredManagementTakeaway: Leadership must choose a route, owner and target date with the consequence of delay visible.

movements.title: Twelve-month transformation blueprint
movements.objective: Show progression from Stabilise through Mature.
movements.transitionPurpose: Close with the future state and the next management checkpoint.
movements.requiredManagementTakeaway: Progress should move from urgent ownership and foundations to repeatability, measurement and oversight.

movements.title: Management conclusion
movements.objective: Close with the transition required and route to Advisory where appropriate.
movements.transitionPurpose: End with a useful narrative management close.
movements.requiredManagementTakeaway: Success is a control environment management understands, owns, monitors and improves deliberately.

requiredConclusion: Explain the current environment, transition required, critical foundations, success at 90 days and 12 months, and when Advisory adds value.
prohibitedClaims: invented incident, loss, customer, supplier, system or interview
legal, regulatory, benchmark, certification or guarantee conclusion
